# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Clipboard shape codec and SVG shape-list writer
  - Files: presstoshape/formats/clipboard.py, presstoshape/formats/svg.py, tests/formats/test_clipboard.py, tests/formats/test_svg.py
  - `MIME_TYPE`, `encode_shapes(shapes) -> bytes` (envelope `format`/`version`/`shapes`), `decode_shapes(data) -> list[Shape]` raising `ClipboardError` (a `P2sError`) on oversize, bad JSON, NaN/Infinity, wrong marker, other version, empty list, any shape error; `write_shapes_svg(shapes, bounds)` with the `viewBox` set to the bounds in doc coordinates, sharing `_shape_element` with `write_svg`
  - Purpose: plain-data clipboard content, lossless inside PressToShape and SVG for other apps (Req 1.2)
  - _Leverage: formats/p2s.py encode_shape/decode_shape/readers/limits, formats/p2s_migrations.CURRENT_VERSION, formats/svg.py _shape_element_
  - _Requirements: 1.2, 3.6, 3.7, 4.2, NFR Security, NFR Reliability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec clipboard, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer focused on file formats | Task: Implement formats/clipboard.py and svg.write_shapes_svg per design.md; tests: round trip of every shape type, nested Composites, rotated text, no-fill/no-stroke styles; each rejection case raises ClipboardError; write_shapes_svg read back with read_svg gives the same shapes at the same coordinates | Restrictions: formats imports only models and geometry; explicit codecs, no reflection; no migrations for the clipboard payload; speaking names, "type" not "kind" | Success: tests green, architecture test green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. Fresh ids, insertion helper and shared delete
  - Files: presstoshape/editing/operations/_document.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/selection.py, tests/editing/test_document_helpers.py (or the existing test module covering _document)
  - `with_fresh_ids(state, shapes)` (recursive through Composite parts), `insert_above(state, new_shapes, anchor_ids, modes=None)` (above the topmost anchor in its container, or on top of the active layer / entered Composite; hidden layer allowed); move `delete_selection`'s removal body into `_delete_selected(state)` used by Delete and later Cut
  - Purpose: one place for copying ids and placing copies (Req 3.2–3.4, 5.1–5.3, 5.6)
  - _Leverage: _document.new_id, containers.change_container / edited_composite / with_parts, queries.active_layer_
  - _Requirements: 2.3, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4, 5.1, 5.2, 5.3, 5.6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec clipboard, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer working on the editing layer | Task: Add the helpers per design.md; tests: ids unique and from next_id including nested parts, insertion above the topmost anchor in a layer and in an entered Composite with modes, insertion on top of a hidden active layer, Delete behaves exactly as before (existing tests stay green) | Restrictions: reach shapes only through containers, never layer.shapes in edit mode; shapes stay frozen (dataclasses.replace) | Success: tests green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. Clipboard and duplicate operations
  - Files: presstoshape/editing/operations/clipboard.py, presstoshape/editing/operations/__init__.py (registration import if needed), tests/editing/test_clipboard.py
  - `ClipboardContent`; `copy_selection`, `cut_selection`, `paste(session, native, svg, center)`, registered `duplicate_selection` (`edit.duplicate`, enabled with a selection), `duplicate_and_move(session, dx, dy)`; bounds through a throwaway PathCache (`geometry_bounds`, zero-size padded); native first, SVG fallback, foreign SVG flattened in order; text into an entered Composite becomes a path; status messages and undo labels per design
  - Purpose: the user-visible behavior below views (Req 1–5, 6.3)
  - _Leverage: task 1 codec, task 2 helpers, queries.selected_shapes, svg.read_svg_with_notes, paths._to_path, transforms.translate, render.paths.PathCache_
  - _Requirements: 1.1–1.6, 2.1–2.3, 3.1–3.10, 4.1–4.3, 5.1–5.6, 6.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec clipboard, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer working on editor operations | Task: Implement the operations per design.md; tests per the design's unit-test list (copy has no side effects, cut one undo step and closes an emptied Composite, paste centers / in place, unique ids on repeated paste, native preferred, SVG fallback for broken or other-version native, foreign SVG with layers and groups, nothing pasteable gives status and no undo step, hidden layer, entered Composite with new-part mode and text→path, duplicate placement/order/modes, duplicate_and_move one step) | Restrictions: operations take plain values, no Qt; catch parse errors only at the paste boundary; one session.edit per command | Success: tests green, architecture test green. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 4. Qt clipboard glue, commands, menu and shortcuts
  - Files: presstoshape/views/clipboard.py, presstoshape/views/keymap.py, presstoshape/views/actions.py, presstoshape/views/main_window.py, tests/views/test_clipboard.py
  - `put(content)` (native, image/svg+xml, image/x-inkscape-svg, text/plain), `read() -> (native, svg)` (SVG-looking plain text accepted, oversized ignored), `can_paste()` (formats only); window commands edit.cut/copy/paste/paste_in_place; KEYMAP bindings (standard Cut/Copy/Paste keys, Ctrl+Shift+V, Ctrl+D); Edit menu order; `AppActions.set_enabled`; MainWindow enables Cut/Copy from selection and Paste from `can_paste()`, refreshed on `QClipboard.dataChanged` (disconnected in closeEvent)
  - Purpose: connect the operations to the system clipboard and the UI (Req 3.11, 7)
  - _Leverage: task 3 operations, CanvasView.view_center, existing WINDOW_COMMANDS pattern_
  - _Requirements: 1.5, 3.1, 3.11, 4.1, 7.1–7.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec clipboard, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: PySide6 developer | Task: Implement the views part per design.md; offscreen tests for put/read/can_paste; QTest scratch script on the real window, offscreen and on the desktop (GL): Ctrl+C/V, Ctrl+Shift+V, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+X on the canvas, Ctrl+C in the layer-rename editor copies text not shapes, Paste enabling follows the clipboard | Restrictions: QClipboard only in views/clipboard.py; connect triggered via lambda; no defensive try/except around Qt calls; delete scratch files one command each | Success: tests green, flows verified on both renderers. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 5. Alt+drag to duplicate with copy preview
  - Files: presstoshape/tools/select.py, presstoshape/tools/base.py, presstoshape/render/overlay.py, presstoshape/render/picture.py, presstoshape/views/canvas_view.py, presstoshape/views/cursors.py, tests/tools/test_select.py, tests/render/test_picture.py
  - `_duplicating` flag set on a MOVE press with Alt (handles checked first); release commits `duplicate_and_move` only for a non-zero translation; `CursorType.DUPLICATE` → `DragCopyCursor`; `Overlay.copies`; `DocumentPicture.draw_copies(canvas, copies, matrix)` recorded once per gesture, drawn after the document in `CanvasView._paint`
  - Purpose: duplicate-and-place in one gesture (Req 6)
  - _Leverage: SelectTool MOVE mode, Overlay.matrix, DocumentPicture recording, tests/helpers.ToolDriver_
  - _Requirements: 6.1–6.6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec clipboard, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Python developer working on tools and Skia rendering | Task: Implement Alt+drag per design.md; tests: Alt+drag duplicates and moves (one undo step, copies selected, originals unchanged), Alt click without movement does nothing, Alt on a scale handle still scales from the center, overlay has copies and no moving ids while duplicating, cursor DUPLICATE; CPU-surface pixel test that originals stay and copies draw through the matrix; QTest check on the real window offscreen and with GL | Restrictions: tools stay Qt-free; the recorded document picture must not be re-recorded during the gesture; CursorType only mapped in views/cursors.py | Success: tests green, gesture verified on both renderers, bench_canvas not slower. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._

- [ ] 6. Docs and final check
  - Files: README.md, FAQ.md (if it lists features), .spec-workflow/steering/product.md, CLAUDE.md (only if a new rule emerged), FEATURE_GAPS.md (local, uncommitted)
  - Mention copy/paste/duplicate and Alt+drag where features are listed (hedged wording); product.md current features; tick clipboard/duplicate in FEATURE_GAPS.md and mark the native format as done; full test suite, screenshot, self-test; manual interop note (copy to/from Inkscape, paste into a text editor)
  - Purpose: truthful docs and a verified feature
  - _Requirements: all_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec clipboard, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Developer focused on docs and release quality | Task: Update docs per this task, run `uv run pytest`, `uv run python main.py --self-test`, `uv run python scripts/screenshot_app.py`, and report what the user should check manually (Inkscape interop) | Restrictions: hedged wording, no em dashes in user-facing prose; FEATURE_GAPS.md stays uncommitted; cleanup one command per deletion | Success: suite green, docs match behavior. Before starting set this task to [-] in tasks.md; after finishing log it with log-implementation (with artifacts) and set it to [x]._
